cohort: The study included 221 term male newborns with a gestational age of 37-42 completed weeks.
finding: The mean stretched penile length in Ethiopian newborns was 3.28 ± 0.42 cm, with SPL < 2.43 cm identified as the cut-off for micropenis.
mod_finding: Neonates born via instrumental delivery had larger stretched penile length compared to those delivered by caesarean section or vaginal delivery.
cross-section timing: within the first 72 hours of postnatal age
